scope: Five ESP software resets followed by two-hour four-device diagnostic application monitoring; not power-cycle or full-system acceptance

final_workcost.scope: Cumulative since last software reset; no per-window workcost snapshots

interpretation: Radar sample quality varied from repeated timeouts to a final long run of fresh sampled observations; this does not establish the cause or prove continuous successful reception between samples.
Light and radar faults were not consistently coincident; their causes remain unestablished.
Ordinary firmware still does not advertise SEN0390.
limitations: Snapshots approximately 1.1 seconds apart do not represent every sensor operation or precise transition times.
Software resets do not test loss and restoration of module power; no independent UART or voltage waveform was measured.
Global health counters do not identify a source and can undercount under contention. Event 4 is queue overflow, not device timeout; event 7 is UART RX overflow.
End-only cumulative workcost cannot identify UART byte counts during any specific fault window; discarded flush bytes are not delivered payload.
Light accuracy, physical OLED readability, independent radar ground truth, whole-system allocation compliance and full hardware acceptance remain unverified.
Post-restoration flash comparison covers only the prefix through configuration, not the entire 4 MB.
